title: Unit Event — And Now, I Wear This Ribbon — Episode8 The Path I Want To Walk

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon
meta.Episode: Episode8 — The Path I Want To Walk
meta.Event Outline: Noticing how Mafuyu feels more at home surrounded by N25 puts a smile on Mizuki's face. Realizing how they're both alike in that sense, Mizuki recalls their former self before joining N25.

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Wait, us...?
As in the four of us as a group...?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Yes.
I arrived at this decision after seeing this video.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <You both seem to understand how to express what we're feeling in a way that other people would struggle to.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I believe that more people will listen to our songs if you two keep making music videos for them.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <By doing so, I might be able to save someone...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <In order to actually have more people listen, I need your artistic talents, Enanan, as well as your video editing skills, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I promise to draw incredible illustrations for you...!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<I'm happy to hear that as well...!
We'll be looking forward to working with you more, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<I understand...
Once you've made your decision, please let me know whenever.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I still stand by my belief that I want to do what I can to have our songs heard by more people...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <However, I also personally want to see you make more videos...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Because what you make, Amia...
There's so much pain, but also kindness.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I still stand by my belief that I want to do what I can to have our songs heard by more people...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <However, I also personally want to see you make more videos...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Because what you make, Amia...
There's so much pain, but also kindness.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's incredible how she can just say stuff like that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I have all the time in the world since I'm not really going to school...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Plus, it was really fun to make something with other people while chatting with them about stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Being called weird and treated like an outcast... Being torn away from someone I really liked hanging out with...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line:
Mizuki...?
Is now a good time?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Thanks!
I'm actually having some trouble getting my suitcase to close and was hoping you could help.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It won't close...? But you're leaving tomorrow. Are you sure you're gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I'll manage somehow...
Also, there's a couple of things that I want to give you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: This video. Is it the one you were working on for that anime? MiraMagi, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, it's for something else.
I made it for some people I met online...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, one thing led to another and they ended up asking me to make a video for them. I was given a song demo for reference and worked on it with this artist girl.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It was my first time working with another person, so there were some growing pains... But because I did, I think I was able to produce a really good one.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I see...
That explains why you seemed to be having so much fun lately, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I guess it was.
I got a chance to really talk about what I was thinking and feeling, and they understood. Which led to a great result...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm not sure if I should be there with them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't know why I feel that way, but...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Mizuki...
I don't think there's such a thing as a place where you shouldn't be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: You're free to go wherever you wish and stay wherever you like. Conversely, you don't have to go anywhere if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, Mizuki, what do you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I'll be happy as long as you believe in what you believe, Mizuki. I always have and always will.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Don't mind what anybody else thinks, Mizuki. Your feelings come first. That's why I asked.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: This may sound a bit strange or even rude, but I'm actually really glad to see right now that you're so concerned.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Because, until just recently, I thought you'd given up on everything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Like when you stopped wearing that ribbon you like so much. It was as if nothing mattered to you anymore.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: But that doesn't seem to be the case now. You're showing genuine concern for something that you don't want to lose.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: And that makes me incredibly happy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: It's perfectly okay for you to do what you want, Mizuki, because I'm absolutely sure that you'll find others who understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I mean, you're just the cutest!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, you should go where you want to go... And be where you want to be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Until this point, no one seemed to understand what you thought was most important or cared about most.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: You've endured so much already, so I get why you're scared...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
I should return to packing.
Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I wanted to give you this mannequin.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: It's too big for me to take, so I was hoping that you could put it in your room!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: That way, if you ever feel the desire, you could start making clothes again like you used to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Yes. I made it using my favorite kind of fabric. It's cute, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: So, if you ever feel like wearing it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: There's no need to abandon the things that you truly love.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: I don't think I've ever told you this before, but I also thought about abandoning my dream several times.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Luckily, I had you. The look of joy on your face as you wore the clothes and ribbons I'd made prevented me from doing so.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: People may end up saying some really awful things about you. But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line:
Please...
Don't ever forget that I'll always be on your side, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister
rows.Line: Whatever you choose to do in life, I'll be there to support you every step of the way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Whatever I choose to do in life...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm honestly still pretty scared... But...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna give it a try...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This might actually not end up going well.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I might end up back in a place where nothing matters to me anymore.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (For this, I should do absolutely everything I can before even thinking about giving up.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Good evening...
Sorry for the late response.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <Oh, Amia... I'm glad that you're back.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <If possible, I'd like it if we could keep working together...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <After giving this a lot of thought...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I think this is also my first time hearing about your big sister being the one who gave you that push.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I still don't understand why you were so concerned about joining...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Chalk it up to coming of age, I guess♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Well, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I forgot to tell you back then... So, thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you thanking me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For your very first video. If you hadn't used my illustration, we might not be here talking like this right now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! Ena, that's like ancient history now!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Kanade! Mafuyu!
You two hardly ever come here at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I found some time to work...
Also, Kanade wanted to hear what I thought about her new demo.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes.
We even sent messages to both of you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
We were having so much fun talking that we didn't notice at all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, you already made another one?
I still can't believe how fast you work, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Really...?
More importantly, what were you all doing just now?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The past!
We were just talking about how Ena and I joined N25!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
It was nice to learn more about all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see.
When you two first joined... That's very nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I remember feeling so nervous that time...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you were?
You sounded really mature from my point of view.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
R-Really?
I was just trying to be as honest as I could...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that explains why you were so direct with your comments. I guess that's just the way you are, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on. Do you actually remember?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Probably? What's that supposed to mean? Also, you said you liked my illustration that time. Don't tell me you didn't actually mean it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha...!
Yeah, Ena! What they said!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Talk about a huge blast from the past...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We talked about so much too. The good and the bad... But now, I...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hello? Sis?
Thanks for sending me that package!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The new clothes you made were so cute!
I also wore the ribbon you sent right away!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I shared the snacks you sent with everyone from my group. They really enjoyed them, so thanks a bunch.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh...?
How have I been lately?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
Alright, let's get down to... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a file.
Ena's already done. That was fast.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cool! She copied me and paid homage to our first music video!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is really awesome!
And it's gonna look amazing after I throw in a few effects!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So... Let's get down to business!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We're gonna get a ton of people to listen to Kanade and Mafuyu's song through our video.)
